Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا تَوْفِيقَ الطَّاعَةِ
Translation: O Allah, grant us the success to be obedient

Arabic text: وَ بُعْدَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ
Translation: And to stay away from disobedience

Arabic text: وَ صِدْقَ النِّيَّةِ
Translation: And sincerity of intention

Arabic text: وَ عِرْفَانَ الْحُرْمَةِ
Translation: And recognition of the sacred

Arabic text: وَ اَكْرِمْنَا بِالهُدَى وَ الَاسْتِقَامَةِ
Translation: And honor us with guidance and steadfastness

Arabic text: وَ سَدِّدْ اَلْسِنَتَنَا بِالصَّوَابِ وَ الْحِكْمَةِ
Translation: And direct our tongues to speak truth and wisdom

Arabic text: وَ امْلَأْ قُلُوبَنَا بِالْعِلْمِ وَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ
Translation: And fill our hearts with knowledge and understanding

Arabic text: وَ طَهِّرْ بُطُونَنَا مِنَ الْحَرَامِ وَ الشُّبْهَةِ
Translation: And purify our stomachs from the forbidden and the doubtful

Arabic text: وَ اكْفُفْ اَيْدِيَنَا عَنِ الظُّلْمِ وَ السِّرْقَةِ
Translation: And restrain our hands from oppression and theft

Arabic text: وَ اغْضُضْ اَبْصَارَنَا عَنِ الْفُجُورِ وَ الْخِيَانَةِ
Translation: And lower our gazes from immorality and betrayal

Arabic text: وَ اسْدُدْ اَسْمَاعَنَا عَنِ اللَّغْوِ وَ الْغِيبَةِ
Translation: And block our ears from vain talk and backbiting

Arabic text: وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَى عُلَمَائِنَا بِالزُّهْدِ وَ النَّصِيحَةِ
Translation: And favor our scholars with asceticism and sincerity

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْمُتَعَلِّمِيْنَ بِالْجُهْدِ وَ الرَّغْبَةِ
Translation: And the students with diligence and desire for knowledge

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْمُسْتَمِعِينَ بِالْإِتِّبَاعِ وَ الْمَوْعِظَةِ
Translation: And the listeners with following guidance and heeding advice

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَرْضَى الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ بِالشِّفَاءِ وَ الرَّاحَةِ
Translation: And the sick Muslims with healing and comfort

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَوْتَاهُمْ بِالرَّأْفَةِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: And their deceased with kindness and mercy

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَشَايِخِنَا بِالْوَقَارِ وَ السَّكِينَةِ
Translation: And our elders with dignity and tranquility

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الشَّبَابِ بِالْاِنَابَةِ وَ التَّوْبَةِ
Translation: And the youth with returning to You and repentance

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ بِالْحَيَاءِ وَ الْعِفَّةِ
Translation: And the women with modesty and chastity

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْاَغْنِيَاءِ بِالتَّوَاضُعِ وَ السَّعَةِ
Translation: And the wealthy with humility and generosity

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْفُقَرَاءِ بِالصَّبْرِ وَ الْقَنَاعَةِ
Translation: And the poor with patience and contentment

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْغُزَاةِ بِالنَّصْرِ وَ الْغَلَبَةِ
Translation: And the warriors with victory and triumph

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْاُسَرَاءِ بِالْخَلاصِ وَ الرَّاحَةِ
Translation: And the prisoners with freedom and relief

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْاُمَرَاءِ بِالْعَدْلِ وَ الشَّفَقَةِ
Translation: And the leaders with justice and compassion

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الرَّعِيَّةِ بِالْاِنْصَافِ وَ حُسْنِ السِّيرَةِ
Translation: And the citizens with fairness and good conduct

Arabic text: وَ بَارِكْ لِلْحُجَّاجِ وَ الزُّوَّارِ فِيْ الزَّادِ وَ النَّفَقَةِ
Translation: And bless the pilgrims and visitors with provisions and sustenance

Arabic text: وَ اقْضِ مَا اَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ
Translation: And help them fulfill what You have made obligatory upon them of Hajj and Umrah

Arabic text: بِفَضْلِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: By Your grace and mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
